response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates a strong background in software development, including experience with Java and large-scale systems, but his recent roles have focused primarily on non-JVM technologies like TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang. While he has theoretical knowledge of Java and JVM tooling, there is limited evidence of deep, recent hands-on experience with enterprise frameworks (Spring, Hibernate) or IDE internals. His interest in developer tooling is implied but not explicitly demonstrated in his work history.
strengths: Strong track record in software engineering with experience in large-scale systems and microservices
Experience with enterprise-grade tooling and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Altom Consulting, Optilyz)
Proven ability to learn new languages and frameworks rapidly (e.g., DLang, TypeScript)
concerns: Limited recent hands-on experience with Java/Kotlin and JVM ecosystems (only theoretical mention)
No clear evidence of working on IDE internals or language tooling in professional roles
Recent roles heavily focused on web/mobile development rather than enterprise IDE or JVM tooling
